newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Aug trade data expected on Wed - official.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Aug trade data expected on Wed - official.

text.p: Malaysia's August trade data is expected to be released on Wednesday afternoon, an official at the Statistics Department said on Wednesday.
"We plan to send it out to Bernama later this afternoon," the official told Reuters.
The monthly trade data are only released to national news agency Bernama.
Stock and foreign exchange dealers said they expect the August trade balance to swing to a surplus of around 500 million to 600 million ringgit, from a deficit of 624.5 million in July.
